observed.workflow_pre_intervention_source_binding: TRIGGER1_SOURCE_HEAD=git rev-parse HEAD; TRIGGER1_SOURCE_TREE=git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}; dirty checkout rejected
observed.open_issue_finding: dispatch/event SHA can differ from executed checkout SHA when moving main is checked out after issue dispatch

hypothesis: A future Trigger1 result can be scientifically valid yet receive false exact-source provenance if the runtime receipt binds dispatch-event GITHUB_SHA instead of the actually executed checkout SHA.
counterhypothesis: GITHUB_SHA and the post-dispatch checkout of main are always identical for issue-triggered runs.
adjudication: The workflow explicitly checks out moving main and separately captures git rev-parse HEAD. Therefore equality is not guaranteed by workflow semantics; the executed checkout identity must be authoritative and the dispatch SHA retained only as event provenance.

executed tree SHA and clean-source status are persisted

focused static regression prevents reintroduction of GITHUB_SHA as head_sha
the artefact/README.md records the new evidence boundary and next gate
